relationships.subject: covalent organic frameworks
relationships.evidence_quote: This study demonstrates that COFs can function as direct macromolecular antagonists of the CLR/RAMP1 complex

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Calcitonin receptor-like receptor (CLR) and receptor activity-modifying protein type 1 (RAMP1) are key components of the calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) receptor

key_findings: MD and docking simulations suggest TPE-COF, 3D-Py-COF and 4PE-1P-COF bind CLR/RAMP1 with affinity comparable to gepants.
COFs are proposed as direct macromolecular CGRP receptor antagonists (computational only).
